summary: CUDA kernels for hybrid models' recurrent layers: a causal depthwise convolution with its carried window, gated-delta attention and Mamba-2's state-space recurrence, each as a chunked two-pass prefill and a column-invariant column scan with per-column state checkpoints
implementation_scope: FP32 SIMT CUDA: the convolution (width 2 to 8, optional SiLU, per-token checkpoints, window from state_in to state_out) with one thread per channel, or per (channel, 32 rows) for prompts out of place; gated delta with dk 64 or 128 and dv a multiple of 64 (pass 1 per (head, 64-token chunk): L, P, forward-substituted T, T diag(beta), W; pass 2 per (head, 64 value columns) over the chunks; column scan with register state); Mamba-2 with d_state 64 or 128 and head_dim a multiple of 32 (pass 1: decayed C.B and cumulative decays; pass 2 per (head, 32 rows); column scan). Python references for the convolution and Mamba-2 (sequential and chunked); recurrent-state-recovery's chunked_prefill.py is the gated-delta oracle. Projections, gate activations, normalization and the output gate are engine supplied.

agent_guidance.use_when: The model has gated-delta or Mamba-2 layers (hybrid attention/recurrent models) and the engine needs their prefill, decode and verify kernels
agent_guidance.avoid_when: The recurrence differs (RWKV, Mamba-1 per-channel selective scan, lightning attention), state widths fall outside the supported shapes, or an engine-specific fused kernel is already measured faster
provides: Causal depthwise convolution with a carried window (state_in to state_out, in place or not), optional SiLU and per-token checkpoints
A time-parallel prompt convolution equal bit for bit to the row-by-row form
Gated-delta chunked two-pass prefill over 64-token chunks with partial-chunk padding
Gated-delta column scan with one update expression, dot products reduced once and broadcast, and per-column checkpoints

Deferred commit (recurrent-state-recovery's Strategy C) of the convolution window and the gated-delta state on the column scan: per-block pending counts, a double-buffered stash, no round-start copy or checkpoints
Mamba-2 chunked two-pass prefill and column scan with per-column checkpoints
Column invariance: a column alone equals the same column inside a verify, bit for bit
engine_supplies: Input projections into q, k, v, gates, B, C and dt, and the gates' activations and key/query normalization
The output gate and norm after the recurrence
State storage in Core's slots and the prefill scratch
Selection of the accepted checkpoint at commit, or the recorded count and flushes of the deferred commit
preserve: One update expression per recurrence across decode, verify and replay
Per-token decays rounded once from FP64 exp, so a decay near 1 does not drift the state over long decodes
Partial chunks padded with tokens that neither update nor output
Checkpoints equal to the state after each column
A deferred replay applies the update expression to the verify's own stashed operands
adapt: Tensor-core matrix products in the prefill passes with FP32-equivalent accuracy
BF16 inputs and fusing the convolution into the input projection

code_files.purpose: Shapes, inputs and launch interfaces for the convolution, gated delta and Mamba-2
FP32 CUDA convolution, chunked prefills and column scans
Host references: the convolution and Mamba-2 token by token and chunked

requires.hardware: CUDA C++20 on sm_80 or later (up to 96 KiB of shared memory per block); Python 3.11+ for the references
requires.model: Gated-delta layers with dk 64 or 128 and dv a multiple of 64, or Mamba-2 layers with d_state 64 or 128 and head_dim a multiple of 32
requires.workload: Prefill, decode and speculative verify of hybrid models

contract.input: FP32 token rows of q/k/v/gates or x/dt/B/C with strides, per-head A and D, the state, scratch and an optional checkpoint buffer
contract.output: FP32 outputs, the updated state and per-column checkpoints
contract.ownership: The engine owns every buffer; kernels borrow them on the caller's stream. A column scan or the convolution may update its state in place (state_out equal to state_in), and the convolution its rows (out equal to x)
contract.failure: Unsupported widths, mismatched head counts, null buffers and short strides are rejected at launch
contract.core_boundary: Core's StateCache slots hold the states; column checkpoints implement RecurrentCommit::column_checkpoints and recurrent-state-recovery's prepare/commit

validation.host: Chunked Mamba-2 equal to the recurrence for chunks 1, 4, 8 and 64 over 23 tokens; the convolution carries its window across splits
validation.native: Convolution outputs, state and checkpoints, and its prompt form bit for bit equal to the row-by-row form (widths 2 to 8, up to 8192 rows); gated delta (dk 64 and 128) and Mamba-2 (d_state 64 and 128) column scans against FP64 recurrences with checkpoints and five columns at once equal bit for bit to one at a time; 8192-token decodes with slow decays within twice the state error of an FP32 recurrence with correctly rounded decays; both chunked prefills over 300 tokens (four full chunks and a partial one) against FP64 recurrences; the deferred commit of the convolution and gated delta over 160 rounds per shape (dk 64 and 128, dv 64 and 128, abandoned rounds, truncation reruns, flushes, prompt chunks) bit for bit equal to plain decoding
validation.performance: No speed claim; reference SIMT kernels
